take after = to be similar to an older relative in looks or character
fashionable = popular at the moment in clothes or style
casual clothes = comfortable clothes for everyday life, not formal
tracksuit = a loose jacket and trousers for sport
hoodie = a sweatshirt with a hood
trainers = comfortable shoes for sport or everyday wear
jewellery = objects such as rings, necklaces or earrings
make-up = substances put on the face to change how it looks
good-looking = attractive in appearance
bad-tempered = becoming angry easily
easy-going = calm and not easily upset
self-confident = sure of your own abilities
sensitive = easily hurt by what other people say
cheerful = happy and showing it
get dressed = to put your clothes on
grow up = to change from a child into an adult
blonde = having yellow or very light hair
dark-haired = having brown or black hair
straight hair = hair that does not curl
wavy hair = hair with soft waves, not tight curls
